notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
[h1]GOOD NEWS![/h1]

Voice Quest is fully compatible with the Steam Deck! You can seamlessly use the controller, just as you would a gamepad on a PC, to control Shadow Man. Additionally, the touch screen is supported for gameplay interaction. While we recommend using headphones for the best experience, the Steam Deck's built-in microphone works exceptionally well with the game, ensuring a smooth and immersive experience.

-bryanthaboi

notes.title: OH CRAP!
notes.notes: The last update - I broke the timer. But this update - I fixed it.

notes.title: Fixed 100 % Category and a Fancier Leaderboard
notes.notes:
Simply put all the bananas weren't being properly accounted for. But - good news - now they are. Completionists rejoice! You can now complete the 100% category and fight to be the best on the leaderboard.

I also made the leaderboard slightly cuter. Might make a new song for the leaderboard screen soon.

As always, thanks for your support, happy questing!

notes.title: First Update Post Release - Goodbye Job, Goodbye John
notes.notes:
No, I still have a job, and I actually have a few friends named John but, let me explain...

[b]PATCH NOTES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Saying "job" or "john" will register as JUMP
[*] Time will not return to what it was when you originally hit a checkpoint when "returning to checkpoint" from the pause menu
[*] Time saves when you quit the game or return to main menu
[*] New Troll Mask
[*] Win screen will tell you how many bananas you got and the total on the map
[*] You can take off masks and hats entirely
[/list]

It has been fun watching people play my game, and the feedback I've received has been great to help me squash further bugs. I'm just one guy making a game in the attic of my garage, so it's nice to have some help now that the game is out there.

Please continue to spread the word of the game! Thanks for everything.
